atoms.span: The arguments of Legitimately Many by Lee Sharks
Legitimately Many: How the Many-Author Reading of the Socratic–Peripatetic Corpus Embrittled
Crucially, Sharks does not present the reception-history investigation as proof of this hypothesis.
The paper's evidence is organized in a table of 112 textual loci.
It is a reception history of how the many-author interpretation acquired and maintained its authority.
The author also explicitly rejects interpreting the hypothesis as a claim of forgery, hoax or deception.
The paper explicitly corrects an earlier archive deposit, #1583, on this point

mt: LEGITIMATELY MANY ON CHATGPT — A SECTION-BY-SECTION READING AT THE TEXT'S GRAIN: THE CRITERION, FILING BEFORE ARGUMENT, THE WILLS' CHANNEL, SIMPLICIUS, THE SEAM AND ITS EDITIONS, J1–J11, THE ANSWER ENGINE, THE CENSUS COUNTS EXACT
d: THE ARGUMENT ADDRESS FOR LEGITIMATELY MANY, 2026-11-04: twelve sections (the hypothesis and its criterion; filing before argument; the instruments of legitimacy and the wills' shared channel; Simplicius and the rival Categories; the Theophrastus–Aristotle seam and its editions 1497–1866; the joint pattern J1–J11 and the evidence against; Masters, Chroust and Hegel; the answer engine; the 112-locus census; the four mechanisms; what the paper claims and does not), a five-proposition synthesis, the primary source by record, AXN and date, and the companion packet.
reading: The innocent reading first. The composer says it read the deposit's full text and not the packet, and the reading bears that out: it follows the study section by section, keeps the hypothesis, the reception-history finding and the proposed explanation at three levels, and carries the study's own limits.
findings: THE COUNTS EXACT. '79 Loci concerning composing-person count', '67 Presuppose or leave that count unaddressed', '2 Affirm', and for attribution '70 of the 112 loci ... 14 affirm it, 14 set an alternative aside and seven revise it' match §8.3 of #1733 ('Of 112 loci, 79 bear on the count of composing persons. At 67 of them ...'; '70 of 112 loci presuppose it or leave it unaddressed, 14 affirm it ..., 14 set an alternative aside and 7 revise it').

THE CATALOGUE AT ITS GRAIN. 'shares twelve titles with the Aristotelian list, has nine internal doublets', and the Greek alternative title Ὑπομνημάτων Ἀριστοτελικῶν ἢ Θεοφραστείων, are each in the text.

THE LIMITS CARRIED. The Masters exchange's replies 'outside the accessible textual commons', Hegel's lectures largely unexamined, the census incomplete, and the closing qualification that 'The one-maker hypothesis is the governing interpretation, not a conclusion independently established by the 112-locus reception study' all render §0.4, §5.6 and the packet's limits.

THE ANSWER ENGINE SEEN AS A STAGE. The two AI Overview compositions of September 2026 (seated in the Capture Registry) are read as the latest medium of the reception, with the objection 'filed under a person'; the composer, itself an answer engine, does not place itself in that sequence.
GENDER IN THE PARAPHRASE. The composer writes 'he' of Sharks throughout; the text gives no pronoun.
analysis: A full and faithful reading at the work's own grain, every atom carried, the counts and the Greek exact, the three levels of claim kept apart and the limits stated.
